name: @metro-labs/ui
description: Metro control panel: sign in with Google, create an agent, get its API key and MCP endpoint, and see the accounts attached to the agents you own. Talks to the daemon's session-gated /api/agents endpoint — no MCP client, so a page load never touches the agent's MCP session. Built with the Stage design system (@stage-labs/kit) rendered on the web via react-native-web.
